annotation.title_clean: Правовой аспект гражданско-правовой ответственности за причинение вреда действиями квазисубъекта-робота
annotation.title_en: Legal Aspect of Civil Liability for Damages in Tort as a Result of Quasi Party Robot Performance
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Tomsk State University; Elecard Devices (authors unnamed in excerpt)
annotation.summary_en: Russian journal article on civil tort liability for harm caused by autonomous AI robots. It distinguishes AI robots from mechanical machines, identifies liable persons (inventor, programmer, manufacturer, user/owner, third party), and proposes a classifier of tort obligations by object, damage level, liable person and industry, pending recognition of the Robot as a quasi-subject of civil law.
key_provisions_or_claims: Divide robots into autonomous AI 'Robots' and mechanical machines; apply existing law (Civil Code Art. 1095) to the latter.
Autonomous Robots are neither a high-danger source nor a defective product; liability must fall on responsible persons.
Candidate liable persons: inventor, programmer, manufacturer, user/owner, third party.
Courts first exclude defenses such as owner fault, victim intent or consent, third-party takeover, force majeure.
Proposes a classifier by object (A/B/C), damage level (1-3), liable person (I-IV) and OKVED industry to cut procedural costs.
